flows.representativeInput: payload check-report on git fixtures with tests.gate "pnpm verify" (or "pnpm test && pnpm typecheck", or tests.full) and a PASS report whose observation argv is the gate, a single-string gate, sh -c, bash -c, /bin/sh -c, or the two-part gate split across argv
flows.expected: Exit 2 with a message naming flows[i].observations[j], the key (tests.gate/tests.full) and the command; finalize-review refuses the same report.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-6-1] passes (2/2 in the file, exit 0): check-report exit 2 naming flows[0].observations[0] and `pnpm verify`; finalize-review exit 2; bash -c with extra spaces refused.

Probe: all 9 refuse cases exit 2 with "Report flows[0].observations[0] ran the recorded tests.gate command `pnpm verify`" (tests.full named for the full-only fixture). /bin/sh -c, a one-string argv ["pnpm verify"] and ["pnpm","test","&&","pnpm","typecheck"] are refused too.

limits: Matching is exact normalized text plus sh/bash -c with exactly 3 argv items; other wrappers are follow-ups f1-f2.

flows.representativeInput: Same fixtures with argv ["pnpm","test","tests/a.test.ts"]; gate argv with no joycraft.yaml, with a tests: section holding only focused, with no tests: section, and with a broken joycraft.yaml; plus payload check-report on this repo's accepted review-2 report and a scan of all 22 tracked reports
flows.expected: Exit 0 for the focused report and for every project with no recorded gate; older accepted reports still validate.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-6-2] passes: focused argv exit 0 and gate argv with no tests: exit 0.
Probe: focused, no joycraft.yaml, focused-only tests:, no tests: section all exit 0. A FAIL report is stopped by the existing verdict check (exit 1), not the gate check.
payload check-report on accepted review-2.report.json (spec 2) returns ok:true, exit 0. This repo has no joycraft.yaml, so the check does not run here.

Scan of 22 tracked *.report.json (157 observations with argv) with the same matcher: none matches "pnpm test && pnpm typecheck", "pnpm test" or "pnpm typecheck", so recording this repo's AGENTS.md gate later would not refuse an existing report.

findings.summary: Not refused (exit 0): bash -lc "pnpm verify", sh -c "pnpm verify" sh (4 argv items), zsh -c, /usr/bin/env bash -c, env CI=1 pnpm verify, sh -c "CI=1 pnpm verify", and sh -c with a quoted inner string. ranCommand (payload/.joycraft/runtime/completion.mjs:122-123) knows only [sh|bash, -c, cmd]. Receipt spec-06-probe.log.
findings.assumption: The spec names sh -c and bash -c only and the named fixtures pass; wider wrapper forms (combined -lc flags, $0 arg, env prefix) are hardening, not a stated criterion. A small fix: strip leading env/VAR=x words and accept any -*c* flag with a trailing $0.

findings.summary: Equivalent invocations pass: npx vitest run or pnpm exec vitest run for gate "vitest run", pnpm run verify for "pnpm verify", the gate plus trailing args (pnpm verify --reporter=dot), and the first half of a two-part gate (pnpm test, which in this repo is the whole suite).
findings.assumption: Spec says the argv "is that command"; exact text matching is the stated rule and Joycraft names no runner, so aliases are out of scope. Worth a sentence in the reviewer text that the gate in any form is out of a spec review.

findings.summary: A broken joycraft.yaml makes refuseGateRuns return silently, so check-report passes a gate-running report (probe "broken joycraft.yaml" exit 0).
findings.assumption: The code comment says config.mjs reports a broken file; other commands surface it. Acceptable, but finalize-review could fail closed instead.

findings.summary: The idempotent re-finalize path also calls validatePassingReport, so a report accepted before a project records tests.gate, and which ran that gate, would be refused on a later re-check. Not reproduced in this repo (scan: no tracked report matches).

The installed .joycraft/runtime/completion.mjs differs from payload/ and has no refuseGateRuns, so this repo's own check-report/finalize-review do not run the new check until the installed copy is synced.
findings.assumption: The spec says edit payload/ only; syncing the installed copy is integration work for the coordinator.

limits: Spec test changes: none. The commit adds one new test file and edits no existing test file, which matches.
The project gate was not run by this review (spec-tier rule); due at the review boundary or wave end.
